title: Creating a Burst Gauge That Uses TP

posts.author: Dunkle_G
posts.body:
2nd post on the board tonight.
I want to create a single resource bar that acts like a burst gauge for the party to use for special attacks. I've been following a guide created by VisuStella for the gauge itself, and it's fairly straight forward. However, I was curious if I could make it so that the bar acts more like a unified TP gauge for the party to draw from.
I've asked a similar question to this on the forums before, but that was for RPG Maker VX Ace. Great system, but since I'm using MZ now, the help I got from that thread isn't as useful anymore.
I feel like making the gauge use TP IS possible with how it's set up in common events, I'm just unsure how to do it.
(Also, since the guide I'm using does involve some VisuStella plug-ins, I apologize if I should have asked this on the JS Plug-In Support Board. I didn't know whether or not the extent of plug-ins mattered here, since they're only really used for getting the gauge into battles)
Here's the guide I've been following. If I need to clarify anything, please let me know.
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ua6RyOAR6cWPdJGTrmB34kAyJBKogsmag46zcM_Yex8/edit?usp=sharing

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
Just thinking out loud because there are more ways that lead to Rome...
Do you already have a solution for TP to be shared across the entire party? In any case, if you want to make use of the gauge shown with show picture, you could (I think) have the bar length be proportional to party TP by using a script call for showPicture, e.g.:
For initializing:
$gameScreen.showPicture(2, 0, 0, 0, <variable for party TP>, 100, 255, 0);
For updating:
$gameScreen.movePicture(2, 0, 0, 0, <variable for party TP>, 100, 255, 0, 60);
You'd still need a mechanism to update this picture whenever there is a TP change, though. I guess you could do this with a Battle Parallel plugin, or just have a small plugin that calls the common event when there is a TP change.

I don't think there is a way to get the TP of the party leader just with "vanilla" event commands, but you can use a script call for this:
BurstGaugeInitialize would be:
◆Show Picture：#1, BurstBar100, Upper Left (0,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal
◆Show Picture：#2, BurstBarGreen, Upper Left (9,0), (1%,100%), 255, Normal
◆Move Picture：#2, Linear, Upper Left (9,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal, 60 frames (Wait)
◆Control Variables：#0091 Leader TP =
$gameParty.members()[0].tp
◆Script：$gameScreen.picture(2).move(0, 9, 0, $gameVariables.value(91), 100, 255, 0, 60);
And BurstGaugeUpdate would be:
◆Wait：12 frames
◆Control Variables：#0092 Leader Previous TP = Leader TP
◆Control Variables：#0091 Leader TP =
$gameParty.members()[0].tp
◆If：Leader TP ≠ Leader Previous TP
◆Script：$gameScreen.picture(2).move(0, 9, 0, $gameVariables.value(91), 100, 255, 0, 60);
◆
：End
